research_question: Under the frozen finite synthetic tabular distribution and equal aggregate budget, does adaptive shortage observation/allocation improve held-out task fraction relative to static verified reuse?
primary_contrast: paired episode adaptive fraction minus static fraction; six heldout tasks offered per arm; no superiority or equivalence certification
engine: CPU Ollama llama-server / llama.cpp; Q4_K_M, Windows11 Ryzen7 8840HS; GPU not used
candidate_scope: original immutable full native CI candidate; validation/publication pending at registration; identical pair required for final publication; installed package bytes checked against wheel before inference
dependencies: fresh installed agents+ollama environment from frozen uv.lock; 66 distributions; dev-only NumPy2.5.3/SciPy1.18.1 used offline

arms.static: fixed numeric/status/aggregate plan, current-goal-only discovery and static allocation
arms.adaptive: bounded three-goal shortage discovery and adaptive allocation

constant_factors: same roles and initial registered primitive/checker pool
same public contract/practice and private checker
same safe builders and operator grants
analysis_unit: paired synthetic episode; tasks, roles, tokens and model responses are correlated subsamples
independence_limits: Separate databases, CAS, keys and history per arm/block; shared operator, model, CPU and persistent server cache; IID episode assumption is approximate and does not imply independent organizations or model errors.

arm_order: 15 static-first and15 adaptive-first, shuffled with Random(61021) before any inference

power_planning.reason: Degenerate all-success pilot cannot provide a reliable power estimate. Fixed practical local calculation bound permits30pairs; this is explicitly exploratory and underpowered for conservative MCID planning. Do not changeN based on observed direction.

statistics.test: two-sided paired sample-swap randomization,9999resamples,NumPy rng41032; exact enumeration if within limit
statistics.multiplicity: only primary contrast has planned CI/test; all secondary tables descriptive, no favorable selection
statistics.ceiling: Report every raw difference and degenerate variance/interval; no population equivalence interpretation.

secondary: active wall and total wall with cleanup
time to first valid heldout result, null if absent
false accepts, UNKNOWN and unresolved remote effects
qualified ordinary receipts and formation lineage
invalid drafts, transfer uncertainty and observed verification candidates
signed per-category/unit/status costs; nested receipt durations are not total wall
cache_policy: No warmup omitted; setup/loading counted. Dedicated cloud-disabled loopback server keep_alive5m. No global unload/pull/reset. Per-block resident metadata retained; actual cache effects unavailable. Requested options distinguished from independently observed fields.
failure_policy: All30offered pairs/360tasks remain in attempt inventory. Timeout,OOM,budget,parse/validator failure and unqualified outcomes count as unsuccessful, not excluded. No outcome-driven replacement or N increase. Missing native usage charges the finite upper reservation. Empty/missing raw records yield UNKNOWN, not verification PASS. If a source/safety bug requires correction, retain this complete or interrupted cohort and preregister a distinct run; never merge sources.
external_failure_sensitivity: Primary intended-task denominator remains fixed. Separately label non-model startup/transport/source failures and missing records; report complete-case sensitivity only as descriptive with its smaller denominator. Do not replace an invalid pair or silently impute success.
stopping: Only fixedN completion, declared finite token/time ceilings, operator interruption, or concrete safety/source failure; never result direction. Energy/electricity, complete model CPU usage and peak RSS are unavailable and cannot be inferred fromAPIfee0.
outputs: Unique raw run directory; source snapshot, intent/request/response/native usage, all signed original records/CAS, hidden evaluation cases, offline verify/analyze, public-copy redaction mapping. No weights, private keys or operator configuration published.
